fairness_rule: The two lanes must depict the same four semantic keyframes. A lane may change only rendering architecture, not story meaning, food state, meal context, PERSON drawing language, or the physical action contract.

rules: Use real transparent-background output capability for assets that require composition flexibility.
A checkerboard or chroma-colored background painted into RGB pixels is a hard failure.
Use INTERACTION_COMPOSITE when contact geometry is inseparable at asset level.
Use full-frame exception only when a compound interaction asset plus composition cannot preserve the shot.
Do not reuse either of the two previously quarantined PERSON attempts.

For PERSON_CONTEXT_SEATED, bind validated PERSON_STYLE_REF_1 as primary source style authority and validated TARGET_LOOK_BOARD_REF_1 only as auxiliary target-look guidance; never bind rejected PERSON attempts.
All four BODY states are generated in one master-board event.
No labels, speech bubbles, captions, UI, panel numbers, or meaning-bearing text may be baked into the artwork.
Cells are split deterministically after import.
Native board and cell dimensions must be recorded before any upscale.
Food-detail assessment must use both native extracted cell pixels and final delivery-size pixels.

evaluation.board_boundary_fixture_requirement: If board-first remains competitive after BODY4, run one >4 BODY-slide fixture before selecting it as default.
